**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat. **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "home apps strip tiles are buttons not links cannot open in new tab middle click" — 0 hits.

## What happens

On `/_console/home`, each app in the "Your apps" strip is a `button` with an `onClick` that navigates in place. So the browser's link affordances are absent: middle-click and ⌘/Ctrl-click do nothing extra, there is no "Open link in new tab" / "Copy link address" in the context menu, and hovering shows no destination. The browser-pass runners had to open apps by typing their URL (`/_console/apps/showcase_app`).

## Where (objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx` — the tile is `<button type="button" onClick={() => onOpen(app)}>` (around line 131).

## Expected

Each tile is a real link to the app's route (the same address `onOpen` navigates to), keeping its look, so the platform's normal link behaviours work; a plain left-click still navigates in place.
